back_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
Listen to the words of this covenant, and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
Say to them: The LORD, the God of Israel, says this: Cursed is the one who does not obey the words of this covenant,

the covenant which I commanded your forefathers on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, 'Obey My voice and do everything I command you, and you will be My people and I will be your God,'
in order to keep the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is today. Then I answered, 'Amen, O LORD.'
The LORD said to me, 'Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: Listen to the words of this covenant and carry them out.'
For I solemnly warned your fathers, from the day I brought them up out of the land of Egypt until today, warning them again and again, saying, 'Obey My voice.'

But they did not obey or incline their ear; each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to keep but they did not do.
And the LORD said to me, 'There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.'

They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers of old, who refused to obey My words. They have followed other gods to serve them; the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant, which I made with their fathers.
Therefore the LORD says this: Behold, I am about to bring upon them a disaster they cannot escape; they will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.
Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but those gods cannot save them at all in the time of their disaster.
O Judah, your gods are as many as your cities, and the altars you have set up to the Shameful thing are as many as the streets of Jerusalem—altars to burn incense to Baal.
As for you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry or prayer for them, for I will not listen at the time they call out to Me in their disaster.
What right has My beloved in My house, when she has carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom? When you do evil, then you exult.
The LORD once called your name 'a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with fine fruit,' but with the sound of a great roar He has set fire to it, and its branches are consumed.
The LORD of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you, because of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have done, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.
The LORD made it known to me, and I knew; then You showed me their deeds.

But I was like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; I did not know that they had devised plots against me, saying, 'Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more.'
O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the inner being and the heart, let me see Your vengeance on them, for to You I have committed my cause.
Therefore the LORD says this concerning the men of Anathoth who seek your life, saying, 'Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand'—
therefore the LORD of Hosts says this: Behold, I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword; their sons and daughters will die by famine.
There will be no remnant for them, for I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.
